evidence: L20-23 one instrument 513500.XSHG, ma_window 60, sell_bias 0.085, buy_bias 0.045; L66-69 bias = close/MA60 - 1 computed only from bars ending context.previous_date (L48-51); L72-78 next_target is a hysteresis band — flat above +8.5%, invested at/below +4.5%, hold state in between; L43 run_daily(trade_at_open,'09:30'); L128/L140 skips a buy/sell if the open is at limit (a guard, not a limit-up entry). Mechanism is the same shape as this batch's e03a2ef1 Strategy12 (512890 MA250 band), but no shared code — that one is a sleeve inside a composite.

sourceFile: strategies/2026-10-28_十年十倍_纳指_黄金全天候_动态杠杆网格系统-b5dd66eb.py
mechanism: 70/30 nasdaq+gold; margin leverage ratchets up as drawdown deepens
evidence: L27-28 fixed 70% 513100 纳指 / 30% 518880 黄金; L46-63 drawdown = last_price / max(750-day high, now) - 1; L66-69 tiers -10%/-20%/-30% map to leverage 1.3/1.6/2.0; L71-74 RATCHET: g.max_leverage_locked only ever rises, and L57-61 resets to 1.0 only when a new all-time high prints; L76-100 targets = nav*0.30 shield and nav*0.70*locked_leverage with a 5% no-trade band; L17-19 stock_margin subportfolio, L106-115 execute_buy fills the shortfall with margincash_open, L117-123 repays debt; L33 run_daily(...,'14:45'). ⚠ The title says 网格 but the code has NO sell ladder — the ratchet forbids de-levering until a new high, so there is no round-trip rung profit, which is precisely the mechanism 网格's base 598050b9 is registered for (buy at -8/16/24/32%, sell back at +15/30/45/60%). Assigning 网格 on the title would be the 「再」-type title error; the mechanism is a drawdown-triggered leverage overlay on a static 2-asset core.
